water_anchor_from_p1_standard_approx.use: visible water envelope, not a filled rectangle

transition_zone_design_start.use: rear platform, railings, coping and overlapping equipment; not a solid band

background_visible_fraction_design_start.status: unmeasured_design_range; replace with locked P1 mask at G0

remove_by_name_after_object_id_audit: V18 B02 | bridge-side supported landing pad
V18 B02 | three short bridge transition steps
foreground_transition_design_start.instructions: Greybox values only; check tree/equipment collision, contact support, route and fixed-camera silhouette before detailing. Do not recreate an arched bridge on dry land.

camera_facing_cards_design_start.local_coordinates: parent_to_camera; plane center local (0,0,-depth_m), local XY plane faces camera
camera_facing_cards_design_start.ray_visibility: camera_visible; disable unnecessary shadow and reflection participation only
camera_facing_cards_design_start.size_formula_if_camera_changes: full_width = depth * sensor_width_mm / lens_mm; full_height = full_width * resolution_y / resolution_x for current AUTO horizontal fit and square pixels; remeasure on camera change

render_design_start.focus_rule: Use A and B with the same focus. If central equipment is not sharp in both, measure its camera-space median depth and make one documented focus correction; do not sweep focus values.

iteration_rules.after_two_failures: change method: revise T01 occlusion/card projection; if that also fails, use low-complexity curved or 3D proxy for water/far bank
iteration_rules.first_check: G1 no-DOF geometry and background mask before painted detail
iteration_rules.second_check: G2 only A/B DOF and same source layers
iteration_rules.final_check: full image, no-DOF seam diagnostic, mask comparison, source reopen, and honest visual review
